svg.title: Success rate spread against number of runs
svg.desc: A plot of measured success rate (y axis, 0.3 to 1.0) against the number of runs n (x axis: 5, 10, 20, 50, 100) for a simulated system whose true success rate is 0.80, shown as a dashed line with tag 1. For each n, gray dots (tag 3) show 40 single experiments, and a dark bar with caps (tag 2) spans the middle 95% of 10000 experiments: n = 5: 0.40 to 1.00; n = 10: 0.50 to 1.00; n = 20: 0.60 to 0.95; n = 50: 0.68 to 0.90; n = 100: 0.72 to 0.87. The bar gets shorter as n grows.
